xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4657: Add the dashboard schedule dialog, next-run badge and inbox resurfacing for scheduled conversations

plan.title: Add the dashboard schedule dialog, next-run badge and inbox resurfacing for scheduled conversations
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 28 files across 6 subsystems, of which 11 are tests, the frontend CI test list and two docs. This issue is already the dashboard slice split out of PAN-4640; its four parts (dialog, badge, list refresh event, resurfacing) share one operator flow and the PRD keeps each work item at 8 files or fewer with explicit edges, so a further split would add coordination without independent value.

narratives.Problem: PAN-4640 shipped conversation schedules as a backend, sweep and CLI only. The dashboard cannot create, see, pause or delete a schedule; rows do not show that a conversation is scheduled; schedule changes do not refresh the list; and a settled or snoozed conversation stays hidden after its schedule delivers a prompt.
narratives.Proposal: Move presetToCron into @overdeck/contracts so the dialog and CLI share it. Add an in-memory conversation.schedules_changed event (reducer bumps conversationsListRevision) emitted by the schedule door's new emitter from the routes (successful writes) and the sweep (once per changed conversation per pass), with list-cache invalidation at both call sites. The list enrichment returns nextScheduledRunAt and scheduleCount from one grouped query per page over enabled schedules. The sweep clears settle and snooze on the conversation a prompt was delivered to. The frontend adds a schedule dialog (host pattern, mounted in main.tsx) opened from a Schedule… item in the row overflow menu and the tab menu, and a muted CalendarClock badge on rows with an active schedule. Docs updated in features/conversations.mdx and docs/DASHBOARD-ARCHITECTURE.md. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4657.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No schedule surface for linked (other-machine) conversations or Session Vault browse copies
- No per-schedule model or effort, and no new conversation per run
- No cron-to-preset decoding in the edit form, no natural-language recurrence, no time-zone picker beyond a text input
- No change to sweep firing semantics (claim, at-most-once, no retries, archived skip) beyond resurfacing and notification
- No resurfacing on failed or skipped runs, and none from ordinary agent activity
- No new HTTP route, config key or database schema change
- No change to pan conv schedule CLI output or flags
- The row badge has no click action of its own
- No edits to src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts

autoDecisions.summary: Share presetToCron through @overdeck/contracts; the recurrence module re-exports it.
autoDecisions.rationale: The frontend cannot import the croner-based recurrence module; one implementation keeps the dialog and CLI identical.

autoDecisions.summary: Badge counts enabled schedules only (MIN next_run_at, COUNT) via one grouped query per page.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says a paused-only conversation renders no badge and forbids per-row queries.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Emitted on each sweep run' = once per changed conversation per sweep pass; a pass that claims nothing emits nothing.
autoDecisions.rationale: Avoids a list refetch every 60 s for every client while still refreshing after every claimed run.

autoDecisions.summary: Resurface only on delivered runs, on the conversation the prompt was delivered to (clear-chain head).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'when the sweep delivers'; failed or skipped runs put nothing new in the conversation.

autoDecisions.summary: Edit pre-fills the raw cron (Repeat = Custom cron); no cron-to-preset decoding.
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest unambiguous edit flow; presets still overwrite it.
Matches the Pull requests dialog's Unlink precedent inside an explicit dialog.

autoDecisions.summary: Schedule… item hidden for vault browse copies and linked rows, shown on nested rows.
autoDecisions.rationale: The API refuses vault copies with 409 and linked rows belong to another machine; lanes and successors are ordinary conversations.

autoDecisions.summary: Badge text uses formatLocalWhen (extracted from formatSnoozeWake); tooltip 'N active schedule(s) · next run <locale string>'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses the PAN-4639 D13 date wording; the issue asks the tooltip to name the schedule count.

autoDecisions.summary: Open dialog refetches its own list when conversationsListRevision changes.
autoDecisions.rationale: A sweep run then updates next/last run in place without extra polling.

autoDecisions.summary: Set plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting further.
autoDecisions.rationale: This issue is already the split-out dashboard slice of PAN-4640; each work item stays at 8 files or fewer.
